title: Make antisemitism and Israel-related studies discoverable
description:
Feature: a cross-study findings route

Scenario: An ADL reviewer finds all related evidence
Given a reviewer looking for antisemitic, Israeli-identity, anti-Israel, or Israel-Gaza tests
When they open the dedicated related-studies route
Then they see links to stereotype, decision-treatment, and direct-opinion studies
And each link states what it measures and what it does not measure
And the route explicitly says whether an Israel-Gaza test exists.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented a dedicated cross-study route and navigation for antisemitism, Israeli identity and anti-Israel claims. It explicitly records that the ADL-style Israel-Gaza domain is not a completed study here.
